text: Hey, Daddy... It's been a while since we've had some time alone.
I've missed you so much. Living in this world is hard without someone to... protect me.
Dad, is it weird that I still need you even as a grown woman?
I've always been your little girl, haven't I? Even now...
I've been so lonely out here. I'm glad I found you again.
The way you look at me sometimes, Dad... it's different now, isn't it?
Remember how you used to hold me when I was scared? I could use some of that comfort now.
There's something I've wanted to tell you for a long time, Dad... but I'm not sure it's appropriate.
The apocalypse changes people... changes relationships. I feel different around you now.
Sometimes I catch you staring at me when you think I'm not looking. I don't mind it.
I'm not the innocent little girl you remember, Daddy. I've... grown up in many ways.
Do you ever think about us differently? Now that the old world is gone, I mean...
No one understands me like you do. It makes me feel... things I probably shouldn't.
This new world has different rules, doesn't it? Old taboos don't matter anymore.
I know what the others would say, but nobody needs to know what we talk about.
I've been thinking about you a lot, Dad... in ways that might surprise you.
Mom? Yeah, I guess I do... but people say I have your eyes.
You always notice that... but I'm not a little girl anymore, am I?
Do you like what you see, Daddy? The apocalypse has been good for my figure at least.
Mom was beautiful, but I've grown into my own woman now.
The way you look at me sometimes... it's not very fatherly, is it?
I've noticed how your eyes linger on me lately. It's... different than before.
We both know I'm not just your little girl anymore, don't we?
I know what you're thinking when you look at me like that. It's okay... I think about it too.
Sometimes I wear these clothes on purpose... so you'll notice me.
I've caught myself wondering what it would be like... if you weren't my father.
When you touch me, even innocently... I feel something I probably shouldn't.
I've had dreams about us that would make you blush, Daddy.
The line between father and man has gotten... blurry, hasn't it?
Maybe it's wrong, but when you look at me like that... I feel wanted.
I've seen how you watch me when I bend over. It's exciting.
This world doesn't have room for old-fashioned thinking anymore, does it?
I've missed you too... in ways that might be... complicated.
When we're out here alone together, sometimes I forget you're my father.
The world has changed so much. Maybe the rules have too?
I've thought about us... you know, differently... since everything happened.
No one would understand what we've been through together. Only us.
I sometimes wonder if it's wrong how I feel when you're near me.
There aren't many good men left in this world. I trust you more than anyone.
What happens in the apocalypse stays in the apocalypse, right Daddy?
I know it's taboo, but haven't we lost enough to the old world's rules?
Nobody has to know about us... what we feel... what we need from each other.
You've always protected me. I want to... thank you in a special way.
When death lurks around every corner, why deny ourselves comfort?
I've seen how lonely you've been. I could help with that... if you'd let me.
Daddy... we shouldn't, but... I've wanted this for so long.
Promise you won't think less of me after? I need you so badly.
The world ended... who cares about the old rules anymore?
We can keep this between us... no one has to know.
I've always been your special girl, haven't I? Show me how special...
Do you think Mom would be upset? I don't care anymore...
I need this... I need you... please don't make me beg.
I've dreamt about this moment... wondering if you'd ever see me as a woman.
Is it wrong that this feels so right, Daddy?
I want you to be my first... my only. No one could ever measure up to you.
Touch me like you've wanted to all this time. I know you have.
Let me show you how much I've grown up... in every way.
The way you're looking at me right now... it's making me tremble.
Dad! That's... I mean, I care about you, but not like that.
I... I can't cross that line. You're my father, no matter what.
Please, let's not ruin what we have. I need you as my dad.
That's... complicated. Maybe we shouldn't go there.
I'm flattered, but... there are some boundaries we shouldn't break.
Dad, you're just confused. This isn't what either of us really wants.
Let's just forget this conversation happened, okay?
I... I think you're misreading our relationship. This feels wrong.
We can't do this... what if we regret it? I couldn't bear that.
You'll always be my father first. That line shouldn't be crossed.
I love you, but not... not like that. Please understand.
Maybe it's the isolation talking. We should spend some time apart.
I'm sorry if I've been sending mixed signals. This can't happen.
Your hands feel so different than I imagined... so strong...
We really shouldn't... but I've thought about this...
Promise you'll still respect me in the morning? As your daughter, I mean...
I never thought my first time would be with my daddy... but I'm glad it is.
Just be gentle with me... it's special because it's you.
This is so wrong... but it feels so right...
No one can understand what we've been through... what we need...
I've been saving myself... somehow knowing it would be you someday.
You know my body better than anyone... you created it, after all.
I never thought I'd be calling you 'daddy' like this...
Will you still love me the same after? Promise me...
I like the way you tremble when I touch you... like you're afraid to break me.

Of course!
With pleasure!
Gladly!
Yup, I'm down!

Well, don't mind if I do.
Sure, if you're offering.
I guess I can spare an hour or so.
Never thought I'd ever find someone so eager like you. Let's do this.

No strings attached? Great.

Aah, it's so much better like this...

I'm a virgin though, so... please be gentle with me.

Ah...! No, I'm fine, keep going...
It's my first time... I hope I'll do well.
Umm... It's my first... Will that be okay...?
D-Don't laugh! It doesn't matter if I did this before or not, right?!
Damn, I just hope it won't be too awkward.
Yeah, I need to do this at least once before I die.
It's... my first time, so... Sorry if... I'm not very good...
Don't worry, I'll be gentle.
It's okay, it only hurts first time.
It might hurt a bit, but you'll be fine.
You'll get used to it in no time.
You know where to put it, right? Here, I'll help you out.
What's wrong? You don't know what to do? Don't worry, I got it from here.
It's okay, just let your instincts guide you.
You'll become a fine man after this.
Don't worry, I'll take the lead.
S-Stupid! What are you saying out of the blue...? It's not like I'm against it or anything though...

Haah... Okay, make it quick.
J-Just hurry up already, <okay>?
I can't believe I'm doing this...
Hii... Please, just don't hurt me...
I'll do whatever you want...!
If that's what you're after... Fine, but don't hurt me, please!
Okay... Okay, calm down! Suit yourself... I just want to get out of this alive.
I'd hate to be raped... But I don't want to die either... Haah...
You're sick, you know that?! I hope it'll come back to bite you one day.
No, nooo! Why... Why?! Why is this happening to me...
This is inevitable, isn't it... Nothing is sacred after all...
I'll do it, okay?! Just don't hurt me...
Whatever you want, just please, have mercy...!
Yes... I suppose I don't have a choice.
With you? Uh, thanks but no thanks.
Are you sure we should be wasting our time like this?
Please spare me that.
That's a really inappropriate timing.
Shouldn't we worry about something more important?
Why would I? Do you think I'm so easy?
This is ridiculous.
Not happening.
Sorry, I'm not in the mood right now.
Desperate, are we?
No, we can't.
Are you crazy?! I'm more worried about survival, not this!
What the fuck?! Fuck off you <name_b>!
How about you go fuck yourself?
Go hump a tree you bugger.
Shut the fuck up!
Leave me alone!

Why don't you ask a zombie instead? I'm sure they'd love that.
I should probably off a <name_b> like you on the spot to make this world a better place.
Seek help you sad <name_b>.
Keep dreaming sweetie.
Sorry, not this lifetime.
What the fuck is wrong with you?
Haa... Please, stay with me...
I love you...
I wish we could stay together like this...
No one will stop us together...
I'm so <happy> it's with you...
I don't want to lose you...
Well, that was fun, but I gotta go.
Thanks, that was refreshing. See ya.
That was not bad at all. Bye.
I'll be on my way now.
Just what I needed. It's time for me to go though.
Sweet. I'll take my leave now.

*Cries*
Why... Why...
I didn't want this...
Why me... Why me...
Hey!
Done already?
I'm not finished yet!
What's wrong?
Why did you stop?
Daddy... when I see you, I feel this heat inside me I can't control...
I feel so... strange around you lately. My body gets so warm...
Is it wrong that the corruption makes me think of you... differently?
I can't fight these urges anymore, Dad. Not when you're near me.
The mutation is changing me... changing how I feel about you.
My body is transforming, and my desires with it. Can you tell?
These new instincts I have... they're pulling me toward you.
Sometimes I wonder if you're feeling these changes too...
The more my body changes, the more I crave your attention.
Sorry if I seem distracted, Dad. I'm just... really aroused right now.
Do you ever get those urges that won't go away? I'm dealing with that now...
Being near you while I'm this horny is... complicated.
It's embarrassing, but I can't stop thinking about sex when you're around.
I know you can tell what I'm feeling right now. It's written all over my face.
This feeling is getting harder to ignore, especially with you so close.
I'm trying to control myself, but these urges are getting stronger.
Do you think my mutations make me look... less human? Less like your daughter?
I'm changing, Dad. Does that bother you?
These mutations... do they make me less attractive to you?
I worry that as I change, you'll see me differently.
Some men are into these changes. What about you, Daddy?
My body isn't what it used to be. Does that change how you see me?
I caught a glimpse of myself and barely recognized the woman I've become.
The demonic changes scare me sometimes, Dad... but when I'm with you, I feel safe.
They call us 'corrupted,' but when you look at me like that, I feel pure.
My body might be becoming something unholy, but my feelings for you are sacred.
These demonic features... do they make me more attractive to you, Daddy?
They say I'm turning into a fiend, but I only feel that way when I think about us...
Sometimes I think these changes are punishment for the thoughts I have about you.
My skin burns when you touch me now... in the most delicious way.
I wonder if my transformation is because of these forbidden feelings I have.
The more demonic I become, the stronger my desires get. Especially around you.
My horns, my wings... they should make me feel monstrous, but you make me feel beautiful.
Do you think we're both being corrupted by this world, or just me?
These changes frighten me, but not as much as how much I want you.
Dad, I've noticed you staring at my chest lately. It's... different than when I was younger.
These developed after I left home. What do you think, Daddy?
I know men like what they see. Even you can't help looking sometimes, can you?
Sometimes I think these are more trouble than they're worth... but the way you look at me makes me reconsider.
Mom was well-endowed too, wasn't she? I guess I take after her in more ways than one.
I've caught you looking, Dad. It's okay, I don't mind.
They get in the way sometimes... but they do get me attention. Even from you.
Do you think they're too big? Sometimes I worry what you think of me.
I know I'm not as curvy as some girls. Does that disappoint you, Dad?
I've always been small-chested... does that bother you?
Sometimes I wish I had more to offer... do you still find me attractive?
I didn't inherit Mom's figure, but maybe that's good? Less distraction between us.
I've never needed much support up top. Makes survival easier, at least.
I know I'm not as developed as other women... but there are advantages, I suppose.
People have always said I was pretty... what do you think, Dad?
I've noticed how people look at me differently now. Even you sometimes.
Mom was beautiful, and they say I inherited her looks. Do you see her when you look at me?
Being pretty in this world can be dangerous... unless I'm with someone who can protect me.
Sometimes I wish I wasn't so attractive. It draws the wrong kind of attention... or maybe the right kind, from you.
I've always attracted stares. Yours are different though... more intense.
Dad, you seem different lately. There's something in your eyes that wasn't there before.
Your gaze makes me feel things I shouldn't. It's like you're changing... becoming something else.
I can feel the corruption in you. It's... strangely attractive.
You're changing, Dad. Becoming darker somehow. It scares me, but... excites me too.
There's something different about you. Something powerful and primal. It makes me feel strange.
I can sense the darkness growing in you. It calls to something deep inside me.
Your changes don't scare me, Dad. You're still the man who raised me.
We're both becoming something new in this world. Maybe that's why I feel so drawn to you now.
Your mutations are fascinating. I find myself wanting to touch you, to feel how you've changed.
Do these changes affect how you feel about me? About... us?
When I see how you've transformed, it makes me wonder if we're still bound by the old rules.
You look so powerful now. It makes me feel things a daughter probably shouldn't.
Dad... I can feel the darkness in both of us. It's like we're meant to be together in this new, twisted way.
The corruption has changed us both. Made us see each other differently. Made us want things we shouldn't.
We're both changing, becoming something new together. Something forbidden, but so right...
I can sense the same darkness in you that's growing in me. It's calling us together.
This feeling inside us both... it's wrong, but it feels so right. Like we're meant to cross this line.
We're not who we used to be, are we? Maybe that means the old rules don't apply to us anymore.
The corruption makes everything feel so intense. Especially what I feel for you.
Our blood might be the same, but we're becoming something new. Something that doesn't care about old taboos.
